name: Hope Ribbon
summary:
Hope Ribbon is a virtual reality experience designed to demystify breast cancer screening and encourage early detection.

Developed as an awareness initiative by Imam Abdulrahman Bin Faisal University (IAU), Hope Ribbon lets you live the full journey of a mammogram visit safely, privately, and at your own pace.

- Walk through the hospital entrance and reception, just as a real patient would
